agent_notes.indie.decide: agents (/indie): a bet's state is the owner's call; add --yes only after the owner says so in this session
agent_notes.indie.goal: agents: never ask for the amount in chat and never pass --monthly yourself; give the owner the command to type
agent_notes.indie.income: agents: never ask for the amount in chat and never pass --amount yourself; give the owner the command to type
agent_notes.peer.experiment: agents: one open trial per side; a kept or declined lesson reaches LESSONS.md by pull request, with the numbers
agent_notes.work.task: agents: pass --why, and one --link (a full https:// URL, or LABEL=URL) per file, ticket, or channel the task needs; the task waits in the owner's inbox until accepted
agent_notes.day.send: agents: show the draft first; add --yes only after the user says send
agent_notes.day.update: agents (/work): mark a step running when it starts and done, blocked, or failed when it ends, with a one-line --summary; blocked needs --needs-you (the ask), failed needs --error-class; done runs the step's verify and exits 1 when it fails
agent_notes.day.question.add: agents (/work): a step never asks the user mid-run; save each ask here with --option, --pick, and --recheck (a command that exits 0 while it is still open, or a link you check), then go on
agent_notes.day.question.recheck: agents (/work): run it after the last step, then ask every item it lists in one batched ask with its age; check each `agent` item's link and close a done one
agent_notes.day.start: agents (/work): run once before stage 1; ask its sign-in question right away (the one ask before the batched ask after the last step); give every step the shell traps file it names. --fix changes Claude connector settings: add --yes only after explicit owner approval, then reconnect using an exposed host tool and recheck; never infer approval from a failed preflight
agent_notes.day.check: agents (/work): run before each stage and on each watch pass; run a step it set back for a retry again
agent_notes.day.suggest: plugins: pass a stable --ref from the feed; use this instead of adding a task the owner did not ask for
agent_notes.work.feed.add: plugins: one JSON object per line (id, at, title; source, kind, actor me|other|bot, to_me, text, personal) and --plugin <name>; keep your own store out
agent_notes.work.feed.mark: agents: mark an event personal or work only when the user says so
agent_notes.work.standup: plugins and agents: pass the rows with --rows <file|-> (title, status, owner, keys, project, repos, aliases; optional groups and ticket_projects); relay the counts and the page path, never titles
agent_notes.notify.act: agents: accept or dismiss a suggestion only when the user says so; it decides it in the inbox
agent_notes.day.accept-all: agents: show the group's label, its count, and what Accept all does first; add --yes --count <the count you showed> only after the user says yes
agent_notes.day.dismiss-all: agents: show the group's label and its count first; add --yes --count <the count you showed> only after the user says yes (dismissed suggestions never come back)
agent_notes.work.project.remove: agents: show the project's name first; add --yes only after the user says remove, and prefer archive (it keeps the record)
agent_notes.work.feed.research: agents: open every link `work feed links --pending` lists for the event first; one {url, summary} per link, or {url, opened: false, reason} when it needs a sign-in; never skip a link
agent_notes.approvals.request: agents: read the owner's notes it prints (standing guidance from past decisions) and follow them; act only on approved
agent_notes.work.project.quiz: agents: ask the quiz in chat (format, rubric, questions, logistics), then store only the counts; never write a question or an answer; after misses, re-quiz each miss and store that run
agent_notes.work.project.gate: agents: mark tool, questions, or a link read only after the owner says it is done; reading a link yourself does not count
agent_notes.work.project.check: agents: run --since first to see what changed; then stamp only the sources you read, one ref at a time, never a reference
agent_notes.draft.judge: agents: run it on every draft before `draft replace`; on exit 1 fix the draft (link the open thread, drop a non-member mention, move it to the owning channel) and judge it again; never send
agent_notes.draft.fit: agents: read the thread to its newest message first, pass --seen <its ts>, and follow the kind: none (no reply), emoji (suggest the reaction), ack or stop (use its text), reply (write or keep yours)
agent_notes.draft.replace: agents: every draft goes through this (or `draft check` after a chat tool save); a step that writes drafts declares `uses: slack-draft:<target>`; on a mismatch, tell the owner before anyone sends
agent_notes.data.show: agents: add --keys to check a file's structure (key names and types, never a value); only files at the top of the data root and in jobs/, tutor/, prep/, and linkedin/ print their text to agents; any other file's text (work/, day/, ladders/, cache/, plugins/, out/) prints only to the owner's terminal or the web app, unless the plugin policy sets agent_may_read_business
agent_notes.data.set: agents: set profile name or employer when the owner supplies them; command arguments may appear in process listings and shell history, so never use it for secrets

usage: careerbrew [-h] [--no-watch] [--no-web] [--no-refresh] [--version]

Private, local-first career assistant for programmers. With no command: start
everything (watcher, web app, refresh) and show what matters now.

  {init,metrics,time,telemetry,actions,start,checklist,config,signals,checkup,jobs,cards,learn,goals,approvals,teach,exercises,import,library,drill,work,ladder,data,backup,plugin,privacy,connect,interview,open,report,serve,web,changes,research,interview-patterns,prep,mail,secret,connectors,machine,pair,sync,day,notify,indie,peer,review,draft}
    init                create the private data folder from examples
    metrics             opt-in weekly aggregate metrics (numbers only)
    time                your manual time per action, for time saved
    telemetry           anonymous usage counts to PostHog EU (no content; only
                        after you say yes)
    actions             every action, for agents and people: CLI command,
                        arguments, and how the web app runs it
    start               start everything (the default with no command):
                        watcher, web app, refresh, then what matters now
    checklist           getting started: the first steps for a new user, each
                        done or with the command that does it
    config              settings with defaults: show, set, unset (people and
                        agents)
    signals             what each of your decisions changed: ranks, the
                        question budget, what plugins learn; reset <kind>

    checkup             one pass/fail line per step: pull-only clone, venv,
                        plugins, readiness, privacy, collect, promo coverage
    jobs                job-hunt mode
    cards               flashcards with spaced repetition (FSRS)
    learn               learn a project: sources, cited concepts, mastery,
                        spaced reviews (skills/careerbrew-learn-project)
    goals               your long-term goals and the upcoming goal (only you
                        set them)
    approvals           actions waiting for your approval
    teach               teacher mode: one step at a time (best in the web app)
    exercises           coding exercises in curriculum order
    import              import from other tools
    library             imported notes and guides
    drill               interview tutor
    work                current-job mode
    ladder              promotion ladders
    data                encryption at rest for the data root
    backup              encrypted backups
    plugin              corporate plugins
    privacy             leak checks
    connect             register a work-tool connector (token goes to the
                        Keychain)
    interview           the interview loop for a company: every step, tips,
                        traps, sources
    open                open the web app in your default browser (starts it if
                        needed; never prints the token)
    report              run pages: what each long run did, its blockers, and
                        what to do next
    serve               open the local web app (127.0.0.1 only)
    web                 the web app's sign-in: one token that lasts across
                        restarts
    changes             detect ladder, plugin, company, and source changes and
                        pivot
    research            fresh public information
    interview-patterns  what interview loops share across companies (steps,
                        order, AI policy)
    prep                interactive interview preparation check
    mail                read-only mail metadata: Outlook, Fastmail, Proton
    secret              store a secret in the macOS Keychain
    connectors          configured connectors
    machine             corporate or personal machine role
    pair                pair a corporate and a personal machine
    sync                encrypted bundles between paired machines
    day                 your day: watcher, results, plan, next step
    notify              notifications about important new events: pages, DMs,
                        review requests, mentions, suggestions (opt-in)
    indie               independent mode: your own repos as income bets; rank
                        them, measure outcomes per agent-hour, review weekly
                        (US-112)
    peer                how /indie and /work improve each other: unreviewed
                        peer lessons and source changes, one trial at a time
                        (US-113)
    review              measure outcomes; KEEP / WATCH / PIVOT
    draft               reply drafts that fit the thread's newest state, saved
